venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Hot and humid, highs in the low 90s with afternoon thunderstorms; humid the rest of the night
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 7/11 (MOD MKZ//JK; entered by JK):** Strong start with an Investor Baby Shower — MOD, Key and Lead Line ran the event, which turned out to be solid drinkers, and ~15 N/A Pink Flamingos sold, showing up nicely in the PMix. Key was cut as a closer came in early (6pm). Transitioned into a normal open that stayed quiet until ~8pm when closers arrived; the 9pm Argentina game drew attention in the space. Steady for several hours, then a very large late-night crowd hit around 11pm once the Argentina game ended and the UFC PPV fizzled — big net-sales spikes 11pm–12am. A guest (Bryant Pietri) made a 12:15am 'table' reservation for 10 across 7 rooms expecting a full table; the team pivoted with Patty offering Mezz space and drinks, the group moved toward the DJ space/bar, and MOD sent a round of shots on the house. Late-night incident: two guests got 'into it' at the bar; security and MOD stepped in, no injuries, everyone separated and asked to leave separately after last call — MOD stood at the door with security to ensure they left their own ways. Net $9,455 vs $7,798 target (+21.2%). Food $930, event sales $1,810. Comps $121.25 (employee discount, industry, manager comp, O4W, F&F). Guests 252, check avg $37.52. Kitchen: strong sales; Meal Deal social post went up today. 86'd: Luxardo Maraschino, Lalo. Favorite moment: seeing Bryant Pietri leave happy at the end of the night.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Rainy and stormy, which gave a smaller crowd
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 7/11 (MOD MD/KK & Chef JMS; entered by MD):** A steady and slightly strange night, with rainy/stormy weather trimming the crowd. Multiple small pops — even one right at 1am — and an unusual crowd meant staff and security had to keep close eyes on a few guests; both handled the night well with no incidents. Great early crowd came in to watch the England v Norway World Cup match on the projector (word is spreading — a nice pop right at open). Regular Thomas came in with 20 friends for his girlfriend's birthday; booths were set aside but, as usual, they all wanted to hang at the bar with staff. Net $11,770 vs $11,647 target (+1.1%). Food $362. Comps $212 (1.8%, industry). Guests 407, check avg $28.92. Kitchen: JMS ran a great solo shift with one of the best staff meals. Maintenance: Well 4 chiller; Well 2 sticking sink pedals. Low: cranberry (arriving Monday), Tanqueray. 86: Lalo. Favorite moment: the England v Norway early crowd and Thomas's fun birthday group.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 7/11 (AM Maggie H/Chef Josh; PM Carey & Chef Lucas; entered by Carey):** A wild and fun night — wedding group aside, the room stayed full all night with the host team finding creative solutions to keep butts in seats so the wait list never got past 4 parties; energy started to peter out around midnight. Cafe/AM $1,354.73 (Felix; started cold brew ready at 8am, a couple IRDs, nice cocktail pop before close). D&C PM $13,257.16. Kitchen: great night with Nate, Lucas and Isaias, good dinner rush around 8pm. Events: Day 1 of High School Success meetings with 25 guests 12pm–5pm in Vauxhall (Josh's lunch spread was a hit, Odessa crushed service); on to Day 2 tomorrow. Net sales $14,611.89 vs $17,492 target (-16.5%); net incl. events $37,937.89. Food $2,682.51 (food incl. events $17,382.51). Net event sales $23,326 (event food $8,626). Comps $525.85 (3.60%). Guests 377 (Tock). Injury/incident: yes — reported. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: despite being stacked all night with a possible past-close last call, the team pushed through the late-night rush with amazing attitudes and guest interactions.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: Pretty swell for July aside from storm swells that didn't materialize
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 7/11 (MOD Kyler/Chef Steves; entered by Thomas):** A weird dissonance between heavy books and dead-ass streets — Kyler had built menus to experiment with a hard-open-meets-26-menu scenario, but the mismatch left no good answer for the experiment. Only hit usual weekend flow after ~11:30pm, but birthdays, anniversaries and some 21sts kept things balanced: 7 large parties, 7 solos, 226 covers, 4 investor cocktails. Top sellers: Native Lion, Rosalie, Shinebox/Paper Wasp (tie). Door: a full, bumping room most of the night yet never a waitlist — large party after large party made for a busy room and creative seating (including an 8-top at the bar) that got almost everyone in immediately; calm streets (possibly two FIFA quarterfinals) but larger parties carried the flow. Welcomed our own Haleigh, some returning regulars, Craig (an OG D+C owner), Ezra Knight (now a member), and spontaneous friends. Net $8,096 vs $7,401 target (+9.4%). Food $754, beverage $7,354. Comps $384.69 (shout-out to investors Craig, Ezra and others). Guests 226, check avg $36. Kitchen: lots of late-night snacks. No-shows: Sidharth Anand (2 @ 6pm) and Angelyn Almedina (2 @ 10pm), both charged.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 7/11 (MOD Joe/Oscar & Chef Josh; entered by Joe):** A slower-than-usual Saturday. Started with 116 covers and lots of large parties; the first hour was a little sleepy with a few resys but not many walk-ins. Marquee slowly filled and hit full ~7:30pm; Standing Room took a while but followed, with a waitlist starting around 9pm. Lots of birthdays and anniversaries throughout the night, all excited to celebrate. Weirdly a LOT of no-shows this evening, but the team burned and turned to clear the list promptly. Cleared the waitlist at 11:30pm as Standing Room started to empty; kept Marquee packed until the end with a very smooth last call — drinks flowing and everyone happy. Net $10,619 vs $12,151 target (-12.6%). Food $2,048. Marquee $8,692; Standing Room $1,927. Comps $190 (industry, birthdays, anniversaries, DNL). Guests 255, check avg $100.18. Kitchen: nice work as usual. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: a table that had such a good time they asked Joe and Bailey for a hug.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Hot and humid, a little bit of lightning
venues.narrative: **DC — Saturday 7/11 (MOD Josh/Marcus; entered by Marcus):** Marquee kept a great steady pace all night, with plenty of walk-ins keeping the room fairly full and good communication across floor and bar teams keeping things flowing. Surprisingly no major rush tonight — potentially World Cup. Last call at 1:30am with some campers until 2:20am. Overall smooth sailing. Garden: hot, humid night; opening pushed to a later start, gained a little traction with a couple of campers, and closed just before midnight with remaining tables offered space in Marquee. Marquee bar sales $8,700.22, Garden $744.38, food $1,053.70; total net sales incl. events $8,700.22 vs $8,778 target (-0.9%). Comps $156.98 (marketing $25, community/investor $27.98, DNL $94). Guests 192 (96 reso / 96 walk-in), GCA $42.44. Kitchen: big night, James handled it well and still ran food. To improve: ABK the actual floor/carpet, especially at the pass. Maintenance: lowboy needs a new left-side hinge, curtain coming off rails, service-entrance flooring. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: a party pod's enormous birthday cake.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 7/11 (AM Sam & Chef Lex/Shannon; PM Justin & Chef Marcus/Drew; entered by Alexis):** The busiest Saturday brunch in a few weeks — the team was scheduled perfectly and worked well together, with Kaylee assisting floor and bar; a couple of larger parties, a solid 10–2, a short 2–3 break, then more happy-hour business. Dinner mirrored brunch as the busiest Saturday dinner in a minute: four servers with good support and a full bar team, busy through most of dinner (a fifth server would have helped for about an hour during the rush); things died down quickly around 9pm and the bar felt quiet by 10pm, with a few celebrations and lots of familiar faces. Sun Club: opened to many hotel guests but the heat kept stays short; picked up a little later, everyone off the rooftop by 6:45pm ($364). Hot Eye: quiet start then an extremely busy push — a large bachelor party filled almost the whole bar (bought multiple rounds, including for strangers, plus a generous tip), a lull, then a large service-industry group; a rough end when last-call tourists wouldn't leave, handled with grace ($1,638). Net $13,243 vs $13,000 target (+1.9%). Food $5,497. Comps $513. Guests 335 (Muni Bar AM 115 + PM 220; OpenTable). Kitchen: steady, busy around 7pm, no lows or 86es. Favorite moment: seeing so many friends in one night — it felt like a fall-season groove for a second there.
